objective: Hiển thị frame Live2D thật từ VTube Studio Spout2 trong desktop widget, giữ VRM local làm fallback có kiểm soát.
non_goals: Không bundle, copy hoặc phân phối model Live2D/Hiyori; owner tự chịu trách nhiệm quyền sử dụng asset.
Không mở Spout, frame HTTP hoặc bất kỳ desktop control endpoint nào ra ngoài 127.0.0.1.
Không tự chroma-key nền opaque; widget phải báo rõ để owner bật Transparent in capture trong VTube Studio.
Không đưa raw frame hoặc screenshot vào disk, log, chat context hay training data.
Không thay đổi VTube Studio config ngoài ứng dụng hoặc nhận URL/sender tùy ý từ renderer.
contracts: Only Electron main may start/stop the fixed Spout2 worker; renderer receives a bounded typed status snapshot.
The worker accepts only the fixed sender name VTubeStudioSpout and binds its HTTP server to 127.0.0.1.
Frame bytes remain ephemeral in memory; the worker exposes only the latest bounded PNG and status metadata.
A missing/opaque/failed frame never disables the existing VRM fallback or blocks chat, voice, drag and hover controls.
The bridge process is optional and must fail closed with a stable error code; no arbitrary command or URL is accepted from IPC.
The bridge must not load a second Hina VRM when a healthy Spout frame is active.
acceptance_criteria: With VTubeStudioSpout broadcasting, a real bridge status reports sender, dimensions and frameReady=true without writing frame pixels to disk.
The widget renders the real Live2D frame URL when healthy and falls back to the existing VRM stage after bridge timeout/error.
The bridge reports transparent=false for the current opaque capture and transparent=true once VTube Studio Transparent in capture is enabled.
The widget keeps the native drag surface and exactly three hover-only Voice/Mic/Auto nghe controls in both renderer modes.
Malformed HTTP paths, oversized requests, non-loopback binds and worker stderr do not leak tokens, raw pixels or arbitrary paths.
Desktop build, focused bridge/security tests and the existing desktop smoke pass with Spout disabled in smoke mode.
